t: Flomasta PipeGrip Straight Tap Connection BN is a push-fit water pipe solution designed for connecting 15mm pipe to 3/4" taps. Featuring a dual locking system and WRAS approval, it ensures a leak-free, secure connection. With no tools or hot works needed, it’s the ideal choice for a fast, reliable installation in both copper and plastic pipe systems.
b: Suitable for Hard & Soft Water Areas
